name: M5.RepairSupport.replacement_card
statement: ∀ (A : Finset ℕ) (e q : ℕ), e ∈ A → q ∉ A → (M5.RepairSupport.repaired A e q).card = A.card
guidance: Unfold repaired. q is absent from A.erase e because q∉A; use Finset.card_insert_of_notMem and card_erase_of_mem. The original support A is a Finset, without any assumption on a source residue tuple. Return only tactic lines without a leading by. Preserve the exact target.
